description: Upstream commits from oceanprotocol/ocean-node v4.6.0 imported into AgrospAI/ocean-node on top of the OceanProtocolEnterprise/ocean-node patch set. Generated by the sync tooling; keep in sync with git history.

imported_commits.subject: security updates
imported_commits.resolution: .github/workflows/ci.yml + docker.yml taken from upstream; dependabot.yml added.

imported_commits.subject: bind C2D algorithm container to its DDO
fix logging leak
imported_commits.resolution: validateCommands.ts + test from upstream; OceanNode.ts import union; compute.ts kept ours + commit edits only (serviceResult route is a later wave)

imported_commits.subject: paid/free compute accepts datatoken orders paid by someone else
Isolate C2D inputs per index + restore DIDS/TRANSFORMATION_DID

reconciliation_commit.purpose: All code that is NOT a verbatim upstream change: restoring the enterprise patch set where upstream collided with it, keeping our CI pipelines, and adding the tests/docs for the merge.

details.src/components/core/utils/validateOrders: Upstream resolves the datatoken from receipt.to and fetches getERC721Address() once per transaction; the enterprise patch validates per OrderStarted event (event.log.address + per-event getERC721Address inside try/catch, tolerant of unreadable datatokens). Reconciled: per-event resolution kept, upstream's env-AND payer binding added (dictates consumer===userAddress AND payer===payerAddress when payerAddress is supplied, `!== undefined` so an empty payer fails closed).
details.src/test/unit/computeOrderPayerValidatio: The ported unit test mocked receipt logs as {topics,data} only. Our validator reads the emitting address per event, so the mock now sets `address` (a real receipt log always carries it).
details..github/workflows/ci.yml + .github/workf: Upstream's versions of these workflows publish to upstream registries and replace our release pipeline. Kept our pipelines and adopted only the security hardening from #1495: top-level `permissions: contents: read`, `persist-credentials: false` on every checkout, and the action majors upstream moved to (checkout/setup-node v7, cache v6, upload-artifact v7, download-artifact v8, setup-buildx v4, login v4, build-push v7).
details.docs/upstream-sync-plan.md: The per-wave plan and compatibility contract for the 4.2.0 -> 4.6.0 window (waves 2-4 still pending), plus the wave-1 execution log.

gates.unit: 404 passing, 2 failing (same two environmental failures as the untouched baseline: libp2p listener in networking.test before-all, Invalid PRIVATE_KEY in logging.test after-all; .mocharc.json sets bail:true so the run stops at the first of them)
gates.computeintegration: not run: needs a Barge stack (ADDRESS_FILE / ~/.ocean/ocean-contracts/artifacts/address.json) not present on this host

not_ported_here: Waves 2-4 of the 4.2.0 -> 4.6.0 window (service-on-demand status/outputs/expiry, log+mirror+Comfy+Node 24, resource limits) and every upstream commit marked do-not-port in docs/upstream-sync-plan.md.
